phraseTemplates.takeMeTo: Por favor, leve-me a esta morada:

accommodation.title: Hotel Avenida Palace
accommodation.details: Double room with breakfast (07:00–10:30). Reception is open 24 hours.
accommodation.notes: Say your surname at reception. The room is paid.

tours.title: Tram 28 guided tour
tours.details: Two hours on the famous yellow tram with an English-speaking guide.
tours.notes: Look for the guide with the yellow umbrella next to the tram stop. 5 minutes' walk from the hotel.

tours.title: Fado dinner and show
tours.address:
Rua de São João da Praça 94
1100-521 Lisboa
tours.notes: Take a taxi from the hotel (about 10 minutes).

tours.title: Belém walking tour
tours.details: Monuments of the Age of Discovery. Easy walking, flat.
tours.address:
Padrão dos Descobrimentos
Avenida Brasília, 1400-038 Lisboa
tours.notes: Tram 15 from Praça da Figueira, or a taxi (about 15 minutes).

travel.title: Flight to Lisbon · TP 781
travel.details: Stockholm Arlanda (ARN) → Lisbon (LIS). Arrives 09:50 Lisbon time. Check in 2 hours before.
travel.address:
Aeroporto Humberto Delgado
Alameda das Comunidades Portuguesas, 1700-111 Lisboa
travel.notes: Taxi from the airport to the hotel: about 20 minutes, around 15–20 euros.

travel.title: Flight home · TP 780
travel.details: Lisbon (LIS) → Stockholm Arlanda (ARN). Arrives 19:55 Stockholm time. Leave the hotel by 11:30.
travel.address:
Aeroporto Humberto Delgado
Alameda das Comunidades Portuguesas, 1700-111 Lisboa

restaurants.title: Pastéis de Belém
restaurants.details: The original custard tarts. No booking: the queue moves fast.

restaurants.title: Time Out Market
restaurants.details: Big food hall with many small kitchens. Easy lunch, lots of seats.

sightseeing.title: São Jorge Castle
sightseeing.details: Castle with the best view over Lisbon. Steep cobbles: take tram 28 or a taxi up.
sightseeing.address:
Rua de Santa Cruz do Castelo
1100-129 Lisboa
sightseeing.ref: Tickets: buy at the gate (senior discount)

sightseeing.title: Santa Luzia viewpoint
sightseeing.details: Viewpoint with tiles and benches, on the way down from the castle.

sightseeing.title: Belém Tower
sightseeing.details: Tower by the river. You can just look from outside.

sightseeing.title: Lisbon Oceanarium
sightseeing.details: Large aquarium. Lifts everywhere, many benches.
sightseeing.notes: Metro red line to Oriente, or a taxi (about 20 minutes).

documents.title: Passport copies
documents.details: Copies only: keep the real passports in the hotel safe.

tips.title: Pavements are slippery
tips.details: Lisbon's stone pavements (calçada) are steep and slippery, especially when wet. Wear shoes with good grip and use the trams and taxis for hills.

tips.title: Tram, metro and bus card
tips.details: Buy a “Viva Viagem” card at any metro station machine and top it up. One card per person.

tips.title: Water and tipping
tips.details: Tap water is safe to drink. In restaurants, rounding up or leaving 5–10% is normal.

tips.title: Pharmacies
tips.details: A pharmacy is a “Farmácia”, marked with a green cross. Pharmacists give good advice for small health problems.

tips.title: Taxis
tips.details: Taxis are beige or black-and-green. Ask the hotel to call one. Show the driver the address card from “Say it”.

contacts.title: Hospital de São José (emergency department)
contacts.details: Public hospital with a 24-hour emergency department, 10 minutes from the hotel. In an emergency call 112.
contacts.notes: Bring the passport and the insurance certificate.

contacts.title: SNS 24 health line (Portugal)
contacts.details: National health advice line, 24 hours. Choose English.

contacts.title: Embassy of Sweden (demo entry)
contacts.details: For lost passports and serious problems.
contacts.notes: DEMO: check the phone number and opening hours at swedenabroad.se before you travel.

contacts.title: Demo Travel Insurance AB
contacts.details: Call the claims line before you pay for a doctor or hospital, if you can.

phrases.local: Onde fica a casa de banho?
Uma mesa para dois, por favor.
Onde fica a farmácia mais próxima?

phrases.en: Can you write it down, please?
Can you speak more slowly, please?
phrases.local: Pode falar mais devagar, por favor?
